## Frequently Asked Questions

**Can I change plans anytime?**  
Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Changes take effect immediately.

**Is there a setup fee?**  
No, we don't charge any setup fees. You only pay for the resources you use.

**What payment methods do you accept?**  
We accept all major credit cards, bank transfers, and can arrange enterprise invoicing.

**Do you offer discounts for annual billing?**  
Yes, save 20% when you pay annually. Contact our sales team for details.
